WHAT YOUR PLAN MAKES POSSIBLE

Start with the frontend. Grow into a full app.

Free gives you visual editing, version history, and source downloads to explore a frontend idea on your own. Builder adds a backend, database, user authentication, team collaboration, custom domains, and room for several live apps. Pro gives a larger team more credits and publishing capacity.

Collaborator limits are proposed and count people invited to an app, excluding its owner. They are not limits on the people using your finished app. Shared workspaces and collaboration require a paid plan; workspace membership is separate from the per-app collaborator limit. Building by collaborators uses the app owner’s credits. A source download includes code, not app users or business data; version restore changes code, not data. Custom-domain registration is purchased separately.

One credit value. Every plan.

100 credits = $1 of Atomic usage. Credits pay for building and running your apps at Atomic’s usage rates. The same work uses the same credits on every plan; charges can be fractional, based on the resources used. For example, 15 credits means $0.15 of Atomic usage. A credit is not a message or a completed app.

A FEW PRACTICAL DETAILS

Before you choose.

Can I subscribe today?

Not yet. These are proposed launch plans. The early-access form adds you to the waitlist; it does not create an account, reserve a price, or start a subscription.

What is included in the subscription?

Builder includes 2,500 monthly credits and up to 3 published apps for $25/month. Pro includes 5,000 monthly credits and up to 10 published apps for $50/month. Both include a backend, database, user authentication, team collaboration, custom domains, private projects, and source downloads. Builder proposes 5 invited collaborators per app; Pro proposes 10. Collaborators can work together with Editor and Admin roles, using the app owner’s credits. Your subscription pays for the platform as well as the included usage.

How does Free work?

The proposed Free plan includes 250 credits once at signup, with no monthly refill. Build on your own and publish one frontend-only app on an Atomic subdomain within your available trial allowance. Free does not include a backend, database, user authentication, or collaboration. Those features, custom domains, and credit purchases require Builder or Pro. When the signup credits are used, upgrade to Builder or Pro to continue building.

Do unused credits expire?

Monthly subscription credits reset at renewal and do not roll over. Purchased top-up credits do not expire. Monthly credits are used before purchased credits. Free receives only its one-time signup grant, with no monthly refill; its expiry terms will be confirmed before launch.

Is hosting included?

Your included credits can pay for metered hosting and persistent storage. Hosting is not unlimited, and storage can still cost credits when an app is stopped. We plan to let you protect part of your balance for hosting. Storage, bandwidth, concurrency limits, and hosting exhaustion and retention rules will be published before billing opens.

What happens when my credits run out?

There are no automatic overage charges. New builds require enough available credits. Free users can upgrade when their signup credits run out. On Builder and Pro, you can buy 1,000 more credits for $10 or wait for your monthly allowance to renew. Running apps also need available hosting funds. The planned hosting-budget control will let you set aside credits that building cannot spend.

Will there be annual billing?

The launch proposal is monthly billing only. Annual plans and discounts have not been announced.

What happens if I cancel?

Cancellation, data retention, export access, and the behavior of published apps will be specified in the final subscription terms before checkout becomes available.
